lines.en: I make my way to the archery range to find Touka wandering around the grounds and...observing the architecture or something.
lines.zh: 我来到弓道场，发现 Touka 在场地里转悠……在观察那栋建筑还是干嘛。

lines.en: To be honest, she looks a little lost. Though, that could just be me having a hard time linking her ojousama persona to sports, even {i}with{/i} her constant insistence that she’s very athletic.
lines.zh: 说实话，她看着有点迷路的样子。不过也可能只是我很难把她那「大小姐」人设跟体育联系起来——{i}尽管{/i}她一再坚称自己很擅长运动。

lines.en: I guess if there was going to be a sport that would fit her, though, this would be it. There’s a certain level of elegance when it comes to archery that, whether or not I can believe it, Touka possesses.
lines.zh: 不过我想，要真有一项运动配得上她，那非弓道莫属。弓道里有种独特的优雅——不管我信不信——Touka 是具备的。

lines.en: Or...{i}would{/i} possess if she would stop wandering around and talking about the craftsmanship of every single wooden structure she encounters.
lines.zh: 或者说……只要她别老转悠、还对她遇到的每一座木造建筑的「工艺」评头论足，就{i}具备了{/i}。

lines.en: As it turns out, Touka has the same level of appreciation for history that her mother does, and she spends the rest of the morning lecturing me about the origins of kyudo and what early examples of it looked like.
lines.zh: 事实证明，Touka 跟她母亲一样欣赏历史——她花了一上午剩下的时间给我讲弓道的起源、以及它早期的样子。

lines.en: It {i}also{/i} turns out that her skills in the art are not as polished as the rest of the girls in the club as of yet, but that she’s working hard to improve and doesn’t plan on giving this up.
lines.zh: 结果还证明，她的弓道技艺还没社团里其他女孩那么纯熟——不过她正在努力进步，{i}也{/i}没打算放弃。

lines.en: I admire how headstrong she is and how, even when it comes to things other than kyudo, she never seems to stray from her goals.
lines.zh: 我佩服她的倔强——佩服她即便面对弓道以外的事，也好像从不偏离自己的目标。

lines.en: Before I leave, we take a quick walk around the archery range and she invites me over to her home sometime in the future to see the one her dad built for her.
lines.zh: 临走前，我们绕着弓道场快走了一圈，她邀我改天去她家，看看她父亲为她建的那个。

lines.en: But, knowing that there’s nothing more to the invitation than providing her with another opportunity to give me a history lesson, I don’t accept right away and ask her to let me sleep on it instead.
lines.zh: 可我知道，这邀约无非是想再给我上一堂历史课，所以我没当场答应，而是让她容我「考虑一晚」。

lines.en: In the end, I leave without making any plans and Touka goes back to wandering around.
lines.zh: 最后，我没定下任何约定就走了，Touka 则回去接着转悠。
